text:
**Uncertain as stated—it depends on altitude and viewing conditions.** The familiar claim is misleading.

NASA says the Great Wall **generally is not visible to the naked eye from low Earth orbit**: it is narrow and blends into the surrounding terrain. Some astronauts have reported seeing sections under exceptionally favorable conditions, so “never visible” is also too absolute.

It is **not visible from the Moon**, and photographs taken with telephoto lenses do not demonstrate naked-eye visibility.

*Source: NASA, “China’s Wall Less Great in View from Space” (2005).*
